{{Quote|The Deftoi of Muntro VI in the Outer Rim are staging their decennial Otherworld Arts Festival. A new composition in their quasi-operatic ceremonial artform, which their formal request translates roughly as "highmind stagecraft," dramatizes a bloody period in Naboo's history before the Great Time of Peace.|An announcement from the Office of the [[Music Advisor/Legends|Music Advisor]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Muntro VI''' was a world in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The world was known for its famous [[Otherworld Arts Festival]], an arts festival held every ten years by the [[Deftoi]] of Muntro VI.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Muntro VI was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
